content.intro: In this lesson, you will study working with multidimensional arrays with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you organize indexed data and avoid incorrect indexes or accidental sharing when copying arrays. In this lesson, focus on two-dimensional arrays and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Arrays are fixed-length indexed containers. Check index bounds, iterate from the correct starting point, and choose a suitable search or sorting algorithm for the data and its existing order. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.
